subject: jShiny server v0.94 beta is available

messages.author: 3a3bb3cccb80a871
messages.subject: jShiny server v0.94 beta is available
parts:
Hi,

I'm happy to release a new jShiny server vesion v0.94-beta.

You can find the source code: https://github.com/statsplot/jshinyserver

It's similar to the official open-source shiny server.
  Available for Windows/Linux/Mac
  Serve the static files to improve page load speed

New features:
Support shiny app with Unicode folder names
Support multiple shiny versions (CRAN 0.12.0 - 0.14.2)
Support new features in shiny versions 0.14 (sanitize errors, server-side bookmarking)
Support to start new R instances for each user
Support shiny version(>=0.14) from github or CRAN [Experimental]
Support shiny app inside r markdown file (interactive document) [Experimental]


Hope you enjoy it and let me know about your thoughts.

Thanks,
Fan
